description: Provider-neutral TrustAI evaluation fixtures. Search and price truth is captured separately at execution time.

time_sensitive_truth_policy.execution_rule: Create and freeze a dated truth sheet immediately before a run that requires current product or price evidence.

visual_asset_truth_record_schema.nullability_rule: Not-applicable truth fields may be null only when grading_notes explains why.
